---
name: "nf-core/differential_functional_enrichment"
description: "Run functional analysis on differential abundance analysis output"
keywords:
- "functional analysis"
- "functional enrichment"
- "differential"
- "over-representation analysis"
components:
- "gprofiler2/gost"
- "gsea/gsea"
- "decoupler/decoupler"
- "propr/grea"
- "custom/tabulartogseagct"
- "custom/tabulartogseacls"
- "custom/tabulartogseachip"
input:
- ch_input:
    description: "Channel with the input data for functional analysis.\n\n`input`\
      \ should be the DE statistics obtained from the DE modules, or the\nnormalised\
      \ abundance matrix (in the case of running GSEA). `genesets` is the\ngene sets\
      \ database, in GMT format for all methods. `background` holds the\nbackground\
      \ features, currently only required for gprofiler2.\n`analysis_method` is one\
      \ of gprofiler2, gsea, decoupler or grea.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(input),\
      \ path(genesets), path(background), val(analysis_method) ]\n"
- ch_contrasts:
    description: "Channel with contrast information. `meta_contrast` holds all the\
      \ contrast info,\nsuch as contrast id, variable, reference, target, etc.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), val(meta_contrast), val(variable), val(reference), val(target),\
      \ val(formula), val(comparison) ]\n"
- ch_samplesheet:
    description: "Channel with sample information.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta_exp),\
      \ path(samplesheet) ]\n"
- ch_featuresheet:
    description: "Channel with features information, alongside the features id and\
      \ features symbol\ncolumn names.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta_exp), path(features),\
      \ val(features_id), val(features_symbol) ]\n"
output:
- gprofiler2_plot_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "HTML file; interactive Manhattan plot of all enriched pathways.\
      \ Note that this\nfile will only be generated if enriched pathways were found.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(plot_html) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.gostplot.html"
- gprofiler2_all_enrich:
    type: "file"
    description: "Table listing all enriched pathways that were found by gprofiler2.\
      \ It can be\nempty, if none is found.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(all_enrich)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.all_enriched_pathways.tsv"
- gprofiler2_sub_enrich:
    type: "file"
    description: "Table listing enriched pathways that were found from one particular\
      \ source.\nNote that it will only be created if any were found.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(sub_enrich) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.*.sub_enriched_pathways.tsv"
- gprofiler2_artifacts:
    type: "file"
    description: "PNG file; Manhattan plot of all enriched pathways.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(plot_png) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.gostplot.png"
- gprofiler2_sub_plot:
    type: "file"
    description: "PNG file; bar plot showing the fraction of genes that were found\
      \ enriched in\neach pathway.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(sub_plot) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.*.sub_enriched_pathways.png"
- gprofiler2_rds:
    type: "file"
    description: "RDS file; R object containing the results of the gost query.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(rds) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.gprofiler2.gost_results.rds"
- gprofiler2_filtered_gmt:
    type: "file"
    description: "GMT file that was provided as input or that was downloaded from\
      \ g:profiler if no\ninput GMT file was given; filtered for the selected datasources.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(filtered_gmt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*ENSG_filtered.gmt"
- gsea_report_tsv:
    type: "file"
    description: "Main TSV results report files for the reference and target groups.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(report_tsv_ref), path(report_tsv_target) ]\n"
    pattern: "*gsea_report_for_*.tsv"
- gsea_report_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "Main HTML results report files for the reference and target groups.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(report_html_ref), path(report_html_target) ]\n"
    pattern: "*gsea_report_for_*.html"
- gsea_index_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "Top level report HTML file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index_html)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*index.html"
- gsea_heat_map_corr_plot:
    type: "file"
    description: "HTML file combining heatmap and rank correlation plot.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(heat_map_corr_plot) ]\n"
    pattern: "*heat_map_corr_plot.html"
- gsea_ranked_gene_list:
    type: "file"
    description: "TSV file with ranked gene list and scores.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(ranked_gene_list) ]\n"
    pattern: "*ranked_gene_list*.tsv"
- gsea_gene_set_sizes:
    type: "file"
    description: "TSV file with gene set sizes.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(gene_set_sizes)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*gene_set_sizes.tsv"
- gsea_histogram:
    type: "file"
    description: "Plot showing number of gene sets by enrichment score.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(histogram) ]\n"
    pattern: "*global_es_histogram.png"
- gsea_heatmap:
    type: "file"
    description: "Heat map of the top 50 features for each phenotype in the test.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(heatmap) ]\n"
    pattern: "*heat_map_1.png"
- gsea_pvalues_vs_nes_plot:
    type: "file"
    description: "Plot showing FDR q-value by normalised enrichment score.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(pvalues_vs_nes_plot) ]\n"
    pattern: "*pvalues_vs_nes_plot.png"
- gsea_ranked_list_corr:
    type: "file"
    description: "Ranked gene list correlation profile.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(ranked_list_corr) ]\n"
    pattern: "*ranked_list_corr_2.png"
- gsea_butterfly_plot:
    type: "file"
    description: "Butterfly plot with gene rank plotted against score.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(butterfly_plot) ]\n"
    pattern: "*butterfly_plot.png"
- gsea_gene_set_tsv:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -make_sets is not set to false, TSV files, one file for each\
      \ gene set,\nwith detail on enrichment for each gene.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(gene_set_tsv) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "gene_sets_*.tsv"
- gsea_gene_set_html:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -make_sets is not set to false, HTML files, one file for each\
      \ gene set,\nwith detail on enrichment for each gene.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(gene_set_html) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "gene_sets_*.html"
- gsea_gene_set_heatmap:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -make_sets is not set to false, PNG-format heatmaps, one file\
      \ for each\ngene set, showing expression for each gene.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(gene_set_heatmap) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "gene_sets_*.png"
- gsea_gene_set_enplot:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -make_sets is not set to false, PNG-format enrichment (barcode)\
      \ plots, one\nfile for each gene set, showing how genes contribute to enrichment.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(gene_set_enplot) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*enplot*.png"
- gsea_gene_set_dist:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -make_sets is not set to false, PNG-format enrichment score\
      \ distribution\nplots, one file for each gene set.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(gene_set_dist) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*gset_rnd_es_dist*.png"
- gsea_snapshot:
    type: "file"
    description: "HTML files, one each for positive and negative enrichment, collecting\
      \ elements\nof gsea_gene_set_enplot.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(snapshot)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*_snapshot*.html"
- gsea_archive:
    type: "file"
    description: "Where -zip_report is set, a zip archive containing all GSEA outputs.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(archive) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.zip"
- gsea_rpt:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing the parameter settings used by GSEA.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(rpt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.rpt"
- decoupler_dc_estimate:
    type: "file"
    description: "Files containing the estimation results of the enrichment(s).\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(estimate_files) ]\n"
    pattern: "*estimate_decoupler.tsv"
- decoupler_dc_pvals:
    type: "file"
    description: "Files containing the p-values associated to the estimation results\
      \ of the\nenrichment(s).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pvals_files) ]\n"
    pattern: "*pvals_decoupler.tsv"
- decoupler_png:
    type: "file"
    description: "Files containing the plots associated to the estimation results\
      \ of the\nenrichment(s).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(plot_files) ]\n"
    pattern: "*estimate_decoupler_plot.png"
- grea_results:
    type: "file"
    description: "Main TSV results file from GREA.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(results)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.grea.tsv"
- session_info:
    type: "file"
    description: "Log file containing information about the R session that was run\
      \ for gprofiler2.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(session_info) ]\n"
    pattern: "*R_sessionInfo.log"
authors:
- "@suzannejin"
- "@bjlang"
- "@caraiz2001"
maintainers:
- "@suzannejin"
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/gprofiler2/gost@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/tabulartogseagct@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/tabulartogseacls@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/tabulartogseachip@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/gsea/gsea@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/propr/grea@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/decoupler/decoupler@0.0.0-6d1763b"

process {
    withName: 'GPROFILER2_GOST' {
        ext.args = [
            "--significant true",
            "--measure_underrepresentation false",
            "--correction_method gSCS",
            "--evcodes false",
            "--pval_threshold 0.05",
            "--domain_scope annotated",
            "--min_diff 1",
            "--round_digits 4",
            "--palette_name Blues",
            "--de_id_column gene_id",
            "--organism mmusculus"
        ].join(' ').trim()
    }
}
